Q: Using graphics.h in Codeblocks gives cannot find lbgi error A:

To avoid this compilation error in Dev C++ version 5.2, consider the following four points:

  1. The compiler must be configured to produce 32-bit code: TDM-GCC 4.9.2 32-bit Release

  2. In "Project options - Parameters", only these three parameters are necessary:

    • lbgi
    • lgdi32
    • lcomdlg32

  3. Avoid these three other parameters, whose inclusion causes linking errors:

    • luuid
    • loleaut32
    • lole32

  4. Optionally, you can manually edit the project's .dev configuration file to improve compileability by modifying these nine parameters (the example is for a project called "test"):

FileName=test.dev
Name=test
Linker=-lbgi -lgdi32 -luser32_@@_
OverrideOutputName=Test
30 CompilerSet=3
31 CompilerSettings=0000000100000000000000000
42 FileVersion=1.0.0.0
49 ProductVersion=1.0.0.0
54 FileName=test.cpp

* It is recommended that the notation on line 14 _@@_ notation not be omitted.

Q: What does Kubernetes actually do? A:

If your app needs an entire server to itself, you probably wouldn’t use kubernetes.

If you have a few different apps, and you want to run them on a fleet of machines (with each host running several different workloads at once), and you want to handle fluctuating pulses in workload (traffic) by dynamically scaling the number of copies of each app independently, then you have the use-case to appreciate kubernetes.

Kubernetes is an open source way to facilitate automatically scaling the number of copies of each app, assigning copies to particular hosts (accounting for resource requirements and available capacity), dynamically routing outside traffic to these app instances, testing for nonresponsive copies and routing traffic around them (and resetting them if they stay nonresponsive), connecting network storage volumes to specific hosts where an app needs it, dynamically maintaining internal DNS (and container IPs) to simplify communication between microservices, securely distributing credentials between containers (helping limit the scope so that it is difficult for one compromised app to escalate and impact others), and providing standardised tools and configuration to administer all of this.

Q: Running Renovate CI on Another Branch A:

In GitLab these two environment variables worked for me

RENOVATE_DEFAULT_BRANCHES - branch(es) where renovate is looking for a config file
RENOVATE_BASE_BRANCHES - branch(es) that are scanned for dependencies

Q: Security Vulnerabilities in IoT enabled Medical Device A:

I would take a look at alibaba as many companies source china for manufacturing. Typically knock offs will occur(or its just plain OEM'ed from china) and will prob show up on places like alibaba.
